notes: Lights replace Lamps: down lights, spot lights, panel lights, strip lights and filler lights (bulbs). Each is a point you select, with no fitting in the model, and new lights go on a Lights tag. Placing or selecting a light opens its settings on the right: lumens with watts, colour temperature, beam angle and edge softness, size, position and target. Select several to change them together. Down and spot lights show their position and target points (drag them to move or aim the light) and their beam as a cone. Lights light Quick and Photoreal renders.
